newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real ends up, ignores October's trade gap.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real ends up, ignores October's trade gap.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.08 percent to end at 1.0297 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market in calm trading, despite today's release of a record $1.308 billion trade deficit figure for October, dealers said.
"Trading was even quieter today," a broker said.
"The market had already antecipated the news," said another broker, noting traders had already been expecting gloomy trade figures.
In the floating exchange rate market, the real rose 0.01 percent to close at 1.0352 to the dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real dropped 0.92 percent to end at 1.095 per greenback.
